Here you can test your AI agents without needing a WhatsApp device.

3. The agent will respond with its real configuration

data.api_intro: Use your API Token to interact with your device programmatically. Send messages, query conversations, read contacts and more — all from your own server or application.
data.endpoint_device_info: Get device information (name, status, channel, etc.)
data.endpoint_send: Send a text, image, document or audio message
data.endpoint_conversations: List device conversations with latest messages
data.endpoint_messages: Get messages from a specific conversation
data.endpoint_contacts_create: Create a new contact on the device
data.endpoint_send_bulk: Send bulk messages to multiple recipients
data.webhook_intro: Webhooks notify you in real-time when something happens on your device. Configure your destination URL, choose the events you're interested in, and receive JSON payloads signed with HMAC-SHA256.
data.webhook_event_incoming: When your device receives a new message
data.webhook_event_sent: When a message is sent successfully
data.webhook_event_delivered: When the message was delivered to the recipient
data.webhook_event_read: When the recipient read the message
data.webhook_event_conversation: When a new conversation is created
data.webhook_event_contact: When a new contact is created
data.example_send_text_code:
curl -X POST https://your-domain.com/api/v1/device/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer lnk_your_token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "5212221234567",
    "type": "text",
    "content": "Hello! Your order #1234 is ready for pickup."
  }'
data.example_send_image_code:
curl -X POST https://your-domain.com/api/v1/device/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer lnk_your_token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "5212221234567",
    "type": "image",
    "content": "https://your-site.com/promo.jpg",
    "caption": "Take advantage of our promotion!"
  }'
